name: Church of Our Lady of Perpetual Succour

dated.title: All Souls' Day Mass with blessing of the columbarium

info.adoration: Adoration Room open 6.00am to 10.15pm daily, closed every Wednesday from 10.00am to 12 noon for cleaning.
info.confession: Sacrament of Reconciliation 30 minutes before every weekend Mass, in the Main Church.
devotions: Divine Mercy Devotion: Tuesdays 6.45pm in the Main Church
Rosary Prayers: Monday to Friday 5.15pm in the Main Church
Christian Meditation: Wednesdays 8pm in St John/St Luke room
info.office_hours: Parish Office: Mon & Sat 9am-6pm, Tue-Fri 9am-8pm, Sun 9am-1pm; closed on public holidays. Catechetical Office: Tue/Wed/Fri 9am-3pm, Sat 11am-6pm, Sun 9am-1pm; closed Mon, Thu and public holidays.
good_to_know: OLPS Church carpark is open 5.30am-10.30pm daily; extra parking at St Stephen's School on Saturdays 3pm-7pm and Sundays 8am-2pm.
Standing along the aisles during Mass and services is not permitted; please keep all walkways and exits clear.
Liturgy of the Word for Children at the 10.30am Sunday Mass on the 2nd and 4th Sundays of the month.

events.title: Level 1 Catechism Registration for 2027
events.text: Children born in 2020 may register for Level 1 catechism in 2027. Phase 2 (parishioners within the OLPS parish boundary) runs 17-23 Oct, Phase 3 (all other applicants) 24 Oct-6 Nov. Register online at olps.sg/cats; registration closes 6 Nov 2026.

events.title: Book of Remembrance
events.text: The parish Book of Remembrance is placed in the Main Church from 17 Oct to 2 Nov 2026. Parishioners are invited to inscribe the names of family members and friends who have gone before us.

events.title: CTIS Information Night
events.text: Information night for the Certificate in Theology 1st Semester 2027, 8pm at CTIS. Application forms are available from the CTIS office or www.ctis.sg; closing date 12 Dec 2026. Enquiries: 69028700.

events.title: Milestone Wedding Celebration @ OLPS
events.text: Couples celebrating 5th, 10th, 15th and later multiple-of-5 wedding anniversaries are invited to the 6.30pm Mass followed by a dinner celebration. Register at olps.sg/milestone2026 or contact Patrick at 91797723; registration closes 30 Oct 2026.

events.title: OLPS Family Weekend 2026 (Saturday)
events.text: For families with children aged 7 to 21, 2pm-6.30pm at St Stephen's School. Registration fee $50 per family; enquiries: James at 9880 2203 or familylife@olps.sg.

events.title: OLPS Family Weekend 2026 (Sunday)
events.text: 9am-7.30pm at St Stephen's School, including Mass. Registration fee $50 per family; enquiries: James at 9880 2203 or familylife@olps.sg.
